intro_text: In the spirit of transparency and accountability, we publish annual post-trip reports detailing screening metrics, financial distributions, and project evaluations.

reports.title: 2026 May Recce Post Trip Report
reports.summary: Groundwork assessment report covering Phnom Penh stakeholder engagement, hospital visits, pharmacy research, and Koh Dach Island site exploration.

reports.title: 2024 Post Trip Report
reports.summary: Comprehensive trip report detailing mass village health screening statistics (1,068 villagers screened), LADS scholarship camps, and school support in Poipet.

reports.title: 2023 Post Trip Report
reports.summary: Post-trip evaluation of primary care health screenings, chronic disease follow-up referrals, and student volunteer activities.

reports.title: 2022 Post Trip Report
reports.summary: Post-trip report documenting the resumption of ground operations, health education workshops, and local partner engagement.
